gloss: to overturn; to overthrow; to reverse

definitions.gloss: to overturn; to upset; to capsize
definitions.explanation: To physically turn something upside down or cause it to fall over.

definitions.gloss: to overthrow; to reverse; to overturn
definitions.explanation: To reverse a decision, disprove a theory, or fundamentally change the established order.

examples.japanese: {証拠|しょうこ}が{常識|じょうしき}を{覆|くつがえ}した。
{判決|はんけつ}を{覆|くつがえ}すのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It is difficult to overturn a verdict.

examples.japanese: {強風|きょうふう}で{船|ふね}が{覆|くつがえ}った。
examples.english: The boat capsized in the strong wind.

notes:
VERB TYPE:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive verb)

INTRANSITIVE PAIR:
{覆|くつがえ}る - to be overturned, to capsize (intransitive)

CONJUGATION:
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}) ending in す
・{覆|くつがえ}さない (negative)
・{覆|くつがえ}して (te-form)
・{覆|くつがえ}した (past)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{判決|はんけつ}を{覆|くつがえ}す - to overturn a verdict
・{予想|よそう}を{覆|くつがえ}す - to defy expectations
・{定説|ていせつ}を{覆|くつがえ}す - to overturn an established theory
・{常識|じょうしき}を{覆|くつがえ}す - to turn common sense on its head

USAGE NOTES:
Sense 2 (figurative) is more common in modern usage. Often used in news and academic contexts when discussing revolutionary discoveries or legal appeals.
